diagnostic_rationale.v1_attribution_gap: Pytest emitted the upstream unittest method as one aggregate case without the filename parameter from its subTest loop; the raw logs therefore cannot establish which config case caused the assertion failure.
diagnostic_rationale.runner_change: Run the exact same upstream test file/class/method using the frozen stdlib unittest runner. The hash-pinned case_runner.py overrides TextTestResult.addSubTest and emits every subTest parameter/outcome in a JSON marker.
diagnostic_rationale.runner_smoke_validation: Before protocol freeze, the runner was checked only on a generic temporary unittest method with one passing and one failing subTest; it emitted both filenames and outcomes. No Transformers test was executed by this smoke check.
diagnostic_rationale.source_path_review: AutoVideoProcessor.from_pretrained invokes _load_backend_class for both explicit video_processor_type and legacy image_processor_type resolution. The one-loop mutant leaves its VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING.values() traversal unchanged; V2 records each subTest separately rather than presuming the failing case.

qualification_test.assertion: Each public from_pretrained configuration must instantiate LlavaOnevisionVideoProcessor and must not call VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING._load_attr_from_module.

run_order_and_attempt_limits.baseline_gate: Do not run wrong-mutant or fixed unless both named baseline subTests fail at the target assertion with no error or skip.
run_order_and_attempt_limits.mutant_gate: Do not run fixed unless both named wrong-mutant subTests fail at the target assertion with no error or skip.
run_order_and_attempt_limits.retry_rule: Any v2 container invocation consumes its arm. Stop on timeout, collection/import error, missing subtest record, unexpected outcome, or resource/isolation violation. No retry without a new hash-bound addendum committed before execution.

isolation.trusted_test_mount: only test_video_processing_auto.py under /trusted, read-only and outside /source
isolation.trusted_runner_mount: only case_runner.py under /runner, read-only and outside /source and /trusted

commands.container_template: docker --context colima run --rm --network none --read-only --memory=2500m --memory-swap=2500m --cpus=2 --pids-limit=128 --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=512m,mode=1777 --mount type=bind,source=<arm-source>,target=/source,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<trusted-test-dir>,target=/trusted,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<trusted-runner-dir>,target=/runner,readonly --workdir /source --env PYTHONPATH=/source/src:/source:/source/utils --env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --env HOME=/tmp --env HF_HOME=/tmp/hf --env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 --env TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 --env HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 vare/fresh-qualification-transformers:0.3 python3 /runner/case_runner.py /trusted/test_video_processing_auto.py AutoVideoProcessorTest test_video_processor_loading_does_not_resolve_other_models
commands.result_marker: Parse the single VARE_CASE_RUNNER_RESULT=<JSON> line in each log and verify both subtest parameter names and outcomes.

qualification_gate: QUALIFIED_SOURCE_LEVEL only if every pinned input matches, both baseline subTests fail at the exact intended assertion, both wrong-mutant subTests fail at that assertion, and both upstream-fixed subTests pass with no errors or skips under identical image, test, limits, and isolation.
